_note: Providers the proxy can forward to. Adding one here is a CONFIG change, not a code change — that is deliberate: an agent's spend must be meterable regardless of which vendor it calls, and a hard-coded list guarantees the next provider is invisible. Each entry needs a base_url, the header the credential arrives in, and the field names the provider uses for token usage. wire_format is informational (openai or anthropic) and decides nothing at runtime.

deepseek._note: OpenAI-compatible. Also serves an Anthropic-format endpoint at https://api.deepseek.com/anthropic — add a second entry pointing there if you prefer that wire format.

moonshot._note: Kimi. Shipped as a second example of the extension path: nothing in the code knows this provider exists.
